## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.17 — Stop actually stops

> **Alpha.** Fixes the stuck capture, and removes a recording mode that cannot
> work on modern Android. Your diagnostics report is what made both findable.

### Stop did nothing, and then there was no Stop

Stopping the *stream* and stopping the *capture* are two different things, and
the Lights tab's button did only the first. The capture service kept running
with nothing to feed it — screen still mirrored, notification still up — and
the Sync tab, seeing no stream, offered "Start". At that point nothing in the
app could stop it, which is why the only thing that worked was Android's own
recording indicator.

Two causes, both fixed. The stop path asked the page whether it had started
capture, rather than asking the service whether it was running; the service
outlives the page, so after a reload or a stop from another tab the page was
simply wrong. And the Stop button only appeared when a stream was active,
which is exactly the wrong condition — a capture with no stream is the state
that needs stopping most.

The Lights button now stops capture directly too.

### Full-resolution recording is gone

It could never have worked. From Android 14, one screen-mirror session is
allowed exactly one mirror, and asking for a second does not fail cleanly — it
ends the session. Your log shows the whole capture dying 365ms after the
request, with no error anywhere:

```
08:29:04.811  record: start requested quality=native capture=250x512
08:29:05.176  capture: stopped
```

So the option is removed rather than left to fail. **Nothing is lost:** raise
the capture resolution slider before recording and you get the same result
through a route the platform permits — your own log shows that working, at
942x1920 for 864 frames with no errors. The recording hint now says so.

### Recording is confirmed working

From the same log: three sessions, 312 / 47 / 864 frames, every frame encoded,
no errors, using the colour format the encoder prefers. If the colours in those
files look right, that part is done.

### Not fixed here

Your log also shows the bridge's event stream dropping and timing out
repeatedly. That is a separate problem and I have not touched it — worth a look
if lights feel unresponsive.
